name: Deploy Supabase (Edge Functions)

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "work"]
    paths:
      - "supabase/functions/**"
      - "supabase/config.toml"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Branch/Ref to deploy from (default: work)"
        required: false
        default: "work"
        type: string
      deploy_all:
        description: "Alle Edge Functions deployen (true/false)"
        required: false
        default: "true"
        type: choice
        options: ["true", "false"]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
      SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.ref_name }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20.x

      - name: Verify required secrets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN secret"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "${SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF secret"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Supabase CLI (pinned)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm i -g supabase@2.72.7
          supabase --version

      - name: Login + Link project
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          supabase login --token "${SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN}"
          supabase link --project-ref "${SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF}" --workdir supabase

      - name: Deploy Edge Functions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd supabase
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.deploy_all || 'true' }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "Deploying all functions..."
            # deploy everything (skip _shared)
            for d in functions/*; do
              name="$(basename "$d")"
              if [ -d "$d" ] && [ "$name" != "_shared" ]; then
                echo "-> $name"
                supabase functions deploy "$name"
              fi
            done
          else
            echo "deploy_all=false -> nothing to deploy automatically"
          fi

name: K1W1 Triggered Build
run-name: "EAS ${{ github.event.client_payload.build_profile || github.event.inputs.profile || 'preview' }} • ${{ github.event.client_payload.ref || github.event.inputs.ref }}"

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [trigger-eas-build]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Branch/Tag/SHA to build"
        required: true
      profile:
        description: "EAS build profile (development|preview|production)"
        required: false
        default: "preview"
      job_id:
        description: "Optional build_jobs id to update in Supabase"
        required: false
        default: ""
      autofix:
        description: "Allow workflow to write back lockfile/dev-client fixes"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      strict_lockfile:
        description: "Lockfile policy override (auto|true|false)"
        required: false
        type: choice
        options: [auto, "true", "false"]
        default: auto

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: >-
    k1w1-triggered-build-
    ${{ github.event.client_payload.ref || github.event.inputs.ref }}-
    ${{ github.event.client_payload.build_profile || github.event.client_payload.buildProfile || github.event.inputs.profile || 'preview' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  resolve:
    name: Resolve explicit ref
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      ref: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.ref }}
      profile: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.profile }}
      job_id: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.job_id }}
      autofix: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.autofix }}
      strict_lockfile: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.strict_lockfile }}
    steps:
      - name: Resolve inputs
        id: resolve
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          REF="${{ github.event.client_payload.ref || github.event.inputs.ref || '' }}"
          PROFILE="${{ github.event.client_payload.build_profile || github.event.client_payload.buildProfile || github.event.inputs.profile || 'preview' }}"
          JOB_ID="${{ github.event.client_payload.job_id || github.event.inputs.job_id || '' }}"
          AUTOFIX="${{ github.event.client_payload.autofix || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.autofix) || false }}"
          STRICT_LOCKFILE="${{ github.event.client_payload.strict_lockfile || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.strict_lockfile) || 'auto' }}"

          if [ -z "$REF" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing required ref. Pass client_payload.ref for repository_dispatch or inputs.ref for workflow_dispatch."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "ref=$REF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "profile=$PROFILE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "job_id=$JOB_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "autofix=$AUTOFIX" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "strict_lockfile=$STRICT_LOCKFILE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  build:
    name: Dispatch → EAS Build (reusable)
    needs: resolve
    uses: ./.github/workflows/eas-build.yml
    with:
      ref: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.ref }}
      profile: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.profile }}
      job_id: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.job_id }}
      platform: android
      autofix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.resolve.outputs.autofix) }}
      strict_lockfile: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.strict_lockfile }}
    secrets: inherit

name: Release Build (WAIT)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      profile:
        description: "EAS build profile"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [production, preview, development]
        default: production
      ref:
        description: "Branch/Tag/SHA to build"
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ inputs.ref }}-${{ inputs.profile }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Android Release Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    env:
      EXPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}
      EAS_CLI_VERSION: "16.32.0"
      SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
      SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
      K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY: ${{ secrets.K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY }}
      WORKFLOW_VERSION: "405"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Validate secrets + inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          case "${{ inputs.profile }}" in
            development|preview|production) ;;
            *) echo "::error::Invalid profile: '${{ inputs.profile }}'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac

          if [ -z "${EXPO_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Secret EXPO_TOKEN"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "${{ inputs.profile }}" = "production" ]; then
            if [ -z "${SUPABASE_URL:-}" ] || [ -z "${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY:-}" ]; then
              echo "::error::Production profile uses local Android credentials. Missing SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY."
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Detect package manager / lockfile
        id: lock
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=package-lock.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=npm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=npm-shrinkwrap.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=npm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=yarn.lock" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=yarn" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=pnpm-lock.yaml" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=pnpm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_lockfile=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=npm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup Node (npm cache)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile == 'true' && steps.lock.outputs.package_manager == 'npm'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}

      - name: Setup Node (yarn cache)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile == 'true' && steps.lock.outputs.package_manager == 'yarn'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}

      - name: Setup Node (pnpm cache)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile == 'true' && steps.lock.outputs.package_manager == 'pnpm'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}

      - name: Setup Node (no cache - lockfile missing)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile != 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install deps (package-manager-aware)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          PM="${{ steps.lock.outputs.package_manager }}"
          LOCKFILE="${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}"
          if [ "${{ steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile }}" = "true" ]; then
            case "$PM" in
              npm)
                npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
                ;;
              yarn)
                corepack enable || true
                yarn install --frozen-lockfile || yarn install --immutable || yarn install
                ;;
              pnpm)
                corepack enable || true
                pnpm install --frozen-lockfile || pnpm install
                ;;
              *)
                echo "::error::Unknown package manager '$PM'"
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          else
            npm install --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
          fi

      - name: Install EAS CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm i -g "eas-cli@${EAS_CLI_VERSION}"
          eas --version
          eas whoami

      - name: Export Android signing files (production only)
        if: inputs.profile == 'production'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          BODY="$(node - <<'NODE'
          const payload = { repo: process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY, mode: "production" };
          process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(payload));
          NODE
          )"

          RESP="$(curl -fsS -X POST "${SUPABASE_URL%/}/functions/v1/android-keystore-export" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
            -H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            ${K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY:+-H "x-k1w1-admin-key: ${K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY}"} \
            --data "${BODY}")"

          RESP_JSON="$RESP" node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require("fs");

          function mask(s) {
            if (!s) return "";
            if (typeof s !== "string") s = String(s);
            if (s.length <= 6) return "***";
            return s.slice(0, 2) + "***" + s.slice(-2);
          }

          const resp = JSON.parse(process.env.RESP_JSON || "{}");
          if (!resp.ok) {
            console.error("❌ export failed:", resp.error || "unknown error");
            process.exit(1);
          }

          fs.writeFileSync(
            "android-upload-keystore.p12",
            Buffer.from(resp.keystoreBase64, "base64"),
            { mode: 0o600 }
          );

          const creds = {
            android: {
              keystore: {
                keystorePath: "android-upload-keystore.p12",
                keystorePassword: resp.keystorePassword,
                keyAlias: resp.alias,
                keyPassword: resp.keyPassword,
              },
            },
          };

          fs.writeFileSync("credentials.json", JSON.stringify(creds, null, 2), { mode: 0o600 });

          console.log(
            "✅ wrote signing files (alias=" +
              (resp.alias || "unknown") +
              ", pw=" +
              mask(resp.keystorePassword) +
              ")"
          );
          NODE

      - name: Run EAS build (WAIT)
        id: eas
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          PROFILE="${{ inputs.profile }}"
          EXT="apk"

          echo " Starting EAS build (platform=android, profile=${PROFILE}) with --wait..."

          {
            echo "artifact_ext=${EXT}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

          BUILD_OUTPUT=""
          if ! BUILD_OUTPUT="$(eas build --platform android --profile "${PROFILE}" --non-interactive --wait 2>&1)"; then
            CODE=$?
            echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}"
            echo "::error::EAS build failed (exit ${CODE})"
            exit "${CODE}"
          fi

          echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}"

          UUID_RE='[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}'
          BUILD_ID="$(echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -oE "${UUID_RE}" | head -n1 || true)"
          if [ -z "${BUILD_ID}" ]; then
            BUILD_ID="unknown"
          fi

          BUILD_URL="$(echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -oE "https://expo.dev[^[:space:]]*/builds/${UUID_RE}" | head -n1 || true)"

          {
            echo "build_id=${BUILD_ID}"
            echo "build_url=${BUILD_URL}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Download Android Artifact
        if: steps.eas.outputs.build_id != 'unknown' && steps.eas.outputs.build_id != ''
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build
          OUT="build/k1w1-${{ inputs.profile }}.${{ steps.eas.outputs.artifact_ext }}"
          eas build:download --id "${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}" --output "${OUT}" || {
            echo "::warning::Failed to download artifact"
            exit 0
          }
          ls -lah build || true

      - name: Cleanup signing files
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rm -f credentials.json android-upload-keystore.p12 || true

      - name: Upload Android Artifact
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@4cec3d8aa04e39d1a68397de0c4cd6fb0d8b62a3 # v4
        with:
          name: k1w1-android-${{ inputs.profile }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/*
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Release Build Summary"
            echo ""
            echo "- workflow version: `${WORKFLOW_VERSION}`"
            echo "- Profile: ${{ inputs.profile }}"
            echo "- Ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}"
            echo "- Package manager: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.package_manager }}"
            echo "- Lockfile: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path || 'none' }}"
            echo "- Build URL: ${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_url }}"
            echo "- Build ID: ${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}"
            echo ""
            echo "> Hinweis: Dieser Workflow ist ein manueller Direktpfad und umgeht die App-seitige Single Source of Truth."
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: EAS Build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Branch/Tag/SHA to build"
        required: true
      profile:
        description: "EAS build profile (development|preview|production)"
        required: false
        default: "preview"
      job_id:
        description: "Supabase build job id (optional)"
        required: false
        default: ""
      platform:
        description: "Platform"
        required: false
        type: choice
        options: [android]
        default: android
      autofix:
        description: "Allow workflow to write back fixes (lockfile/dev-client) to the branch"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      strict_lockfile:
        description: "Lockfile policy override (auto|true|false)"
        required: false
        type: choice
        options: [auto, "true", "false"]
        default: auto

  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Branch/Tag/SHA to build"
        required: true
        type: string
      profile:
        description: "EAS build profile (development|preview|production)"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "preview"
      job_id:
        description: "Supabase build job id (optional)"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      platform:
        description: "Platform"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "android"
      autofix:
        description: "Allow workflow to write back fixes (lockfile/dev-client) to the branch"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      strict_lockfile:
        description: "Lockfile policy override (auto|true|false)"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "auto"
    secrets:
      EXPO_TOKEN:
        required: true
      SUPABASE_URL:
        required: false
      SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY:
        required: false
      SUPABASE_APK_BUCKET:
        required: false
      K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY:
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: eas-build-${{ inputs.ref }}-${{ inputs.profile }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  autofix:
    name: Auto-fix repo (optional writeback)
    if: ${{ inputs.autofix == true }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write

    env:
      EXPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}
      EAS_CLI_VERSION: "16.32.0"
      WORKFLOW_VERSION: "405"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: "🧹 Preflight: clean incomplete native dirs"
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Managed workflow guard:
          # If android/ or ios/ exists but is incomplete, EAS can choke.
          # Only delete when we detect it's clearly incomplete.
          if [ -d android ]; then
            if [ ! -f android/build.gradle ] || [ ! -f android/app/build.gradle ]; then
              echo "::warning::Found incomplete android/ directory (missing build.gradle). Removing android/ to allow EAS to regenerate native project."
              rm -rf android
            fi
          fi

          if [ -d ios ]; then
            if [ ! -f ios/Podfile ]; then
              echo "::warning::Found incomplete ios/ directory (missing Podfile). Removing ios/ to allow EAS to regenerate native project."
              rm -rf ios
            fi
          fi

      - name: Detect package manager / lockfile (for cache + install strategy)
        id: lock
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=package-lock.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=npm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=npm-shrinkwrap.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=npm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=yarn.lock" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=yarn" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=pnpm-lock.yaml" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=pnpm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_lockfile=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=npm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Determine strict lockfile policy
        id: strict_lock
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PROFILE="${{ inputs.profile }}"
          OVERRIDE="${{ inputs.strict_lockfile }}"
          case "$OVERRIDE" in
            true|false)
              echo "strict=$OVERRIDE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              ;;
            ""|auto)
              case "$PROFILE" in
                preview|production)
                  echo "strict=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  ;;
                development)
                  echo "strict=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  ;;
                *)
                  echo "::error::Unknown profile '$PROFILE' while computing strict lockfile policy"
                  exit 1
                  ;;
              esac
              ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Invalid strict_lockfile override '$OVERRIDE' (allowed: auto|true|false)"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Setup Node (npm cache)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile == 'true' && steps.lock.outputs.package_manager == 'npm'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}

      - name: Setup Node (yarn cache)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile == 'true' && steps.lock.outputs.package_manager == 'yarn'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}

      - name: Setup Node (pnpm cache)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile == 'true' && steps.lock.outputs.package_manager == 'pnpm'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}

      - name: Setup Node (no cache - lockfile missing)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile != 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies (policy-aware)
        shell: bash
        env:
          STRICT_LOCKFILE: ${{ steps.strict_lock.outputs.strict }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PROFILE="${{ inputs.profile }}"
          PM="${{ steps.lock.outputs.package_manager }}"
          LOCKFILE="${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}"
          if [ "${{ steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile }}" = "true" ]; then
            case "$PM" in
              npm)
                echo "Using npm ci (lockfile: ${LOCKFILE})"
                npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
                ;;
              yarn)
                echo "Using yarn install --frozen-lockfile (lockfile: ${LOCKFILE})"
                corepack enable || true
                yarn install --frozen-lockfile || yarn install --immutable || yarn install
                ;;
              pnpm)
                echo "Using pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (lockfile: ${LOCKFILE})"
                corepack enable || true
                pnpm install --frozen-lockfile || pnpm install
                ;;
              *)
                echo "::error::Unknown package manager '$PM'"
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          elif [ "${STRICT_LOCKFILE}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "::error::Strict lockfile policy enabled for profile '${PROFILE}', but no lockfile was found. Commit package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml before running preview/production builds."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "::warning::No lockfile found in repo. Development profile allows fallback to npm install (non-reproducible)."
            npm install --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
          fi

      - name: Install EAS CLI (pinned)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm i -g "eas-cli@${EAS_CLI_VERSION}"
          eas --version | tee ci-logs/eas-version.log

      - name: Verify EAS auth
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${EXPO_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Secret EXPO_TOKEN"
            exit 1
          fi
          eas whoami | tee ci-logs/eas-whoami.log

      - name: Auto-fix repo (lockfile + dev client) [optional writeback]
        shell: bash
        env:
          TARGET_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          PROFILE: ${{ inputs.profile }}
          PACKAGE_MANAGER: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.package_manager }}
          HAS_LOCKFILE: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile }}
          LOCKFILE_PATH: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}
          ALLOWED_REF_REGEX: "^(work|main|dev|develop|release/.+|feature/.+|hotfix/.+)$"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          PM="${PACKAGE_MANAGER:-npm}"
          echo "🧯 Auto-fix: lockfile + expo-dev-client (development only)."
          if [ "$PM" != "npm" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Auto-fix writeback currently supports npm-managed repos only. Detected package manager '$PM'; skipping writeback path."
            exit 0
          fi

          npm config set package-lock true

          if [ "${PROFILE}" = "development" ]; then
            echo "📦 Ensuring expo-dev-client for development builds..."
            npx --yes expo install expo-dev-client --fix || npx --yes expo install expo-dev-client
          fi

          if [ "${HAS_LOCKFILE}" != "true" ] || [ ! -f "${LOCKFILE_PATH:-package-lock.json}" ]; then
            echo "::warning::No npm lockfile found. Generating package-lock.json (best effort)."
            npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund
          fi

          # Determine if package.json / package-lock.json / .npmrc changed (modified or untracked)
          if ! git status --porcelain -- package.json package-lock.json .npmrc | grep -q .; then
            echo "ℹ️ No CI auto-fix changes to write back."
            exit 0
          fi

          BR="${TARGET_BRANCH:-}"
          if [ -z "$BR" ]; then
            echo "::warning::No TARGET_BRANCH provided; skipping writeback."
            exit 0
          fi

          if echo "$BR" | grep -qE '^[0-9a-fA-F]{7,40}$'; then
            echo "::warning::Ref looks like a SHA ($BR). Skipping writeback."
            exit 0
          fi
          if echo "$BR" | grep -qE '[: ]'; then
            echo "::warning::Unsafe ref ($BR). Skipping writeback."
            exit 0
          fi
          if ! echo "$BR" | grep -qE "${ALLOWED_REF_REGEX}"; then
            echo "::warning::Writeback disabled for branch '$BR' (regex: ${ALLOWED_REF_REGEX})."
            exit 0
          fi

          if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$BR" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::warning::Ref '$BR' is not a remote branch. Skipping writeback."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "✅ Auto-fix changes detected -> committing back to '$BR'."
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add package.json package-lock.json .npmrc 2>/dev/null || true
          git commit -m "chore(ci): auto-fix lockfile/dev-client [skip ci]" || true

          echo "🚀 Pushing to origin $BR (best effort)..."
          git push origin "HEAD:$BR" || echo "::warning::Could not push auto-fix commit (branch may be protected)."

  build:
    needs: [autofix]
    if: ${{ always() && (needs.autofix.result == 'success' || needs.autofix.result == 'skipped') }}
    permissions:
      contents: read

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    env:
      EXPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}
      EAS_CLI_VERSION: "16.32.0"

      SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
      SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
      JOB_ID: ${{ inputs.job_id }}

    steps:
      - name: Validate inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          case "${{ inputs.profile }}" in
            development|preview|production) ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Invalid profile: '${{ inputs.profile }}' (allowed: development|preview|production)"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          if [ -z "${EXPO_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Secret EXPO_TOKEN"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "${{ inputs.profile }}" = "production" ]; then
            if [ -z "${SUPABASE_URL:-}" ] || [ -z "${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY:-}" ]; then
              echo "::error::Production build requires SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (local Android keystore)."
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

          echo "ARTIFACT_EXT=apk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          if [ -z "${JOB_ID:-}" ]; then
            echo "has_job_id=false" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          else
            if [ -z "${SUPABASE_URL:-}" ] || [ -z "${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY:-}" ]; then
              echo "::warning::JOB_ID provided, but SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY missing -> status updates will be skipped."
              echo "has_job_id=false" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            else
              echo "has_job_id=true" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Prepare build diagnostics dir
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p ci-logs

      - name: "🧹 Preflight: clean incomplete native dirs"
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Managed workflow guard:
          # If android/ or ios/ exists but is incomplete, EAS/Expo can choke.
          # Only delete when it's clearly incomplete (missing the canonical files).

          if [ -d android ]; then
            if [ ! -f android/build.gradle ] || [ ! -f android/app/build.gradle ]; then
              echo "::warning::Found incomplete android/ directory (missing build.gradle). Removing to allow managed EAS build to regenerate native project."
              rm -rf android
            fi
          fi

          if [ -d ios ]; then
            if [ ! -f ios/Podfile ]; then
              echo "::warning::Found incomplete ios/ directory (missing Podfile). Removing to allow managed EAS build to regenerate native project."
              rm -rf ios
            fi
          fi

      - name: Detect package manager / lockfile (for cache + install strategy)
        id: lock
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=package-lock.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=npm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=npm-shrinkwrap.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=npm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=yarn.lock" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=yarn" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=pnpm-lock.yaml" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=pnpm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_lockfile=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "package_manager=npm" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          echo "Repo root: $(pwd)"
          echo "Files:"; ls -lah

      - name: Determine strict lockfile policy
        id: strict_lock
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PROFILE="${{ inputs.profile }}"
          OVERRIDE="${{ inputs.strict_lockfile }}"
          case "$OVERRIDE" in
            true|false)
              echo "strict=$OVERRIDE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              ;;
            ""|auto)
              case "$PROFILE" in
                preview|production)
                  echo "strict=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  ;;
                development)
                  echo "strict=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  ;;
                *)
                  echo "::error::Unknown profile '$PROFILE' while computing strict lockfile policy"
                  exit 1
                  ;;
              esac
              ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Invalid strict_lockfile override '$OVERRIDE' (allowed: auto|true|false)"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Setup Node (npm cache)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile == 'true' && steps.lock.outputs.package_manager == 'npm'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}

      - name: Setup Node (yarn cache)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile == 'true' && steps.lock.outputs.package_manager == 'yarn'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: yarn
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}

      - name: Setup Node (pnpm cache)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile == 'true' && steps.lock.outputs.package_manager == 'pnpm'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}

      - name: Setup Node (no cache - lockfile missing)
        if: steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile != 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies (policy-aware)
        shell: bash
        env:
          STRICT_LOCKFILE: ${{ steps.strict_lock.outputs.strict }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PROFILE="${{ inputs.profile }}"
          PM="${{ steps.lock.outputs.package_manager }}"
          LOCKFILE="${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}"
          if [ "${{ steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile }}" = "true" ]; then
            case "$PM" in
              npm)
                echo "Using npm ci (lockfile: ${LOCKFILE})"
                npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
                ;;
              yarn)
                echo "Using yarn install --frozen-lockfile (lockfile: ${LOCKFILE})"
                corepack enable || true
                yarn install --frozen-lockfile || yarn install --immutable || yarn install
                ;;
              pnpm)
                echo "Using pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (lockfile: ${LOCKFILE})"
                corepack enable || true
                pnpm install --frozen-lockfile || pnpm install
                ;;
              *)
                echo "::error::Unknown package manager '$PM'"
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          elif [ "${STRICT_LOCKFILE}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "::error::Strict lockfile policy enabled for profile '${PROFILE}', but no lockfile was found. Commit package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml before running preview/production builds."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "::warning::No lockfile found in repo. Development profile allows fallback to npm install (non-reproducible)."
            npm install --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
          fi

      - name: Install EAS CLI (pinned)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm i -g "eas-cli@${EAS_CLI_VERSION}"
          eas --version | tee ci-logs/eas-version.log

      - name: Verify EAS auth
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eas whoami | tee ci-logs/eas-whoami.log

      - name: Production credential preflight
        if: ${{ inputs.profile == 'production' }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY: ${{ secrets.K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY }}
          WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ inputs.ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "::add-mask::${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}"
          if [ -n "${K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY:-}" ]; then
            echo "::add-mask::${K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY}"
          fi
          node -e '
            const fs = require("fs");
            const payload = {
              repo: process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY,
              mode: "production",
              run_id: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID,
              ref: process.env.WORKFLOW_REF || "",
              profile: "production"
            };
            fs.mkdirSync("ci-logs", { recursive: true });
            fs.writeFileSync("ci-logs/keystore-request.json", JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2));
          '

      - name: Fetch Android keystore (production only)
        if: ${{ inputs.profile == 'production' }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY: ${{ secrets.K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p ci-logs
          HTTP_CODE="$({
            curl --silent --show-error               --retry 3               --retry-all-errors               --connect-timeout 10               --max-time 60               -o ci-logs/keystore-response.raw.json               -w "%{http_code}"               -X POST "${SUPABASE_URL%/}/functions/v1/android-keystore-export"               -H "Content-Type: application/json"               -H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}"               -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}"               ${K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY:+-H "x-k1w1-admin-key: ${K1W1_EDGE_ADMIN_KEY}"}               -d @ci-logs/keystore-request.json;
          })"
          echo "$HTTP_CODE" > ci-logs/keystore-response.http_code
          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "200" ]; then
            node - <<'NODE'
            const fs = require("fs");
            const raw = fs.existsSync("ci-logs/keystore-response.raw.json")
              ? fs.readFileSync("ci-logs/keystore-response.raw.json", "utf8")
              : "";
            const sanitized = raw
              .replace(/[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{24,}/g, "[redacted]")
              .replace(/Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/g, "Bearer [redacted]");
            fs.writeFileSync("ci-logs/keystore-response.sanitized.txt", sanitized);
            NODE
            echo "::error::Keystore export failed with HTTP ${HTTP_CODE}. See sanitized diagnostics artifact."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate keystore export structure
        if: ${{ inputs.profile == 'production' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require("fs");
          const p = "ci-logs/keystore-response.raw.json";
          const raw = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8");
          let data;
          try {
            data = JSON.parse(raw);
          } catch (err) {
            fs.writeFileSync("ci-logs/keystore-response.sanitized.txt", raw.slice(0, 4000));
            console.error("Keystore export is not valid JSON");
            process.exit(1);
          }
          const summary = {
            topLevelKeys: Object.keys(data || {}).slice(0, 20),
            ok: data?.ok === true,
            hasKeystoreBase64: typeof data?.keystoreBase64 === "string" && data.keystoreBase64.length > 0,
            hasKeystorePassword: typeof data?.keystorePassword === "string" && data.keystorePassword.length > 0,
            hasAlias: typeof data?.alias === "string" && data.alias.length > 0,
            hasKeyPassword: typeof data?.keyPassword === "string" && data.keyPassword.length > 0
          };
          fs.writeFileSync("ci-logs/keystore-response.summary.json", JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
          if (!summary.ok || !summary.hasKeystoreBase64 || !summary.hasKeystorePassword || !summary.hasAlias || !summary.hasKeyPassword) {
            fs.writeFileSync("ci-logs/keystore-response.sanitized.txt", JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
            console.error("Keystore export payload missing required fields");
            process.exit(1);
          }
          NODE

      - name: Write Android signing files
        if: ${{ inputs.profile == 'production' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ci/writeAndroidSigningFilesFromExport.js < ci-logs/keystore-response.raw.json

      - name: Update Build Status - Building
        if: env.has_job_id == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TS="$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
          RUN_ID="${{ github.run_id }}"
          PROFILE="${{ inputs.profile }}"
          SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          JSON="$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"building",build_profile:process.argv[1],github_run_id:process.argv[2],started_at:process.argv[3],source_commit_sha:process.argv[4]}))' "${PROFILE}" "${RUN_ID}" "${TS}" "${SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA}")"
          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error             -X PATCH "${SUPABASE_URL%/}/rest/v1/build_jobs?id=eq.${JOB_ID}"             -H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}"             -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}"             -H "Content-Type: application/json"             -H "Prefer: return=minimal"             -d "${JSON}"             || echo "::warning::Failed to update Supabase status (building)"

      - name: Run EAS Build (WAIT)
        id: eas
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PROFILE="${{ inputs.profile }}"
          PLATFORM="${{ inputs.platform }}"
          echo "🚀 Starting EAS build (platform=${PLATFORM}, profile=${PROFILE}) with --wait..."
          BUILD_OUTPUT="$(eas build --platform "${PLATFORM}" --profile "${PROFILE}" --non-interactive --wait 2>&1)" || {
            CODE=$?
            echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | tee ci-logs/eas-build.log
            if echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -q "Generating a new Keystore is not supported in --non-interactive mode"; then
              echo "::error::Android signing keystore is missing on EAS. Fix: run 'eas credentials -p android' once locally (interactive) to generate/upload a keystore, or configure Android credentials in the Expo dashboard, then rerun the workflow."
            fi
            if echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -qiE "build\.gradle|android/app"; then
              echo "::warning::Build mentions Android native files. If this is a managed Expo project, ensure no partial 'android/' folder is committed (or let the workflow preflight delete it)."
            fi
            echo "::error::EAS build failed (exit ${CODE})"
            exit "${CODE}"
          }
          echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | tee ci-logs/eas-build.log
          UUID_RE='[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}'
          BUILD_ID="$(echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -oE "${UUID_RE}" | head -n1 || true)"
          if [ -z "${BUILD_ID}" ]; then BUILD_ID="unknown"; fi
          echo "build_id=${BUILD_ID}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          BUILD_URL="$(echo "${BUILD_OUTPUT}" | grep -oE "https://expo.dev[^[:space:]]*/builds/${UUID_RE}" | head -n1 || true)"
          echo "build_url=${BUILD_URL}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Download Android Artifact
        if: steps.eas.outputs.build_id != 'unknown' && steps.eas.outputs.build_id != ''
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build
          OUT="build/k1w1-${{ inputs.profile }}.${ARTIFACT_EXT}"
          eas build:download             --id "${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}"             --output "${OUT}" || {
              echo "::warning::Failed to download artifact"
              exit 0
            }
          ls -lah build || true

      - name: Upload build diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@4cec3d8aa04e39d1a68397de0c4cd6fb9dce8ec1 # v4
        with:
          name: eas-build-diagnostics-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            ci-logs/eas-version.log
            ci-logs/eas-whoami.log
            ci-logs/eas-build.log
            ci-logs/keystore-request.json
            ci-logs/keystore-response.http_code
            ci-logs/keystore-response.summary.json
            ci-logs/keystore-response.sanitized.txt
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Cleanup signing files
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          rm -f credentials.json android-upload-keystore.p12
          rm -f android/keystore.jks android/app/keystore.jks android/keystore.properties
          rm -f ci-logs/keystore-response.raw.json
          true

      - name: Upload Artifact
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@4cec3d8aa04e39d1a68397de0c4cd6fb9dce8ec1 # v4
        with:
          name: eas-${{ inputs.platform }}-${{ inputs.profile }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: build/*
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" << EOF
          ## EAS Build Summary

          - Workflow version: ${WORKFLOW_VERSION}
          - Repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          - Input ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          - Input profile: ${{ inputs.profile }}
          - Platform: ${{ inputs.platform }}
          - Checked out: $(git rev-parse HEAD)
          - Package manager: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.package_manager }}
          - Lockfile present: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile }}
          - Lockfile path: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }}
          - Strict lockfile policy: ${{ steps.strict_lock.outputs.strict }}
          - EAS CLI: $(eas --version 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
          - Build ID: ${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}
          - Build URL: ${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_url }}
          - Diagnostics artifact: eas-build-diagnostics-${{ github.run_number }}

          Artifacts: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          EOF

      - name: Update Build Status - Success
        if: success() && env.has_job_id == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TS="$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
          RUN_ID="${{ github.run_id }}"
          BUILD_ID="${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_id }}"
          BUILD_URL="${{ steps.eas.outputs.build_url }}"
          SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          JSON="$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"completed",github_run_id:process.argv[1],eas_build_id:process.argv[2],build_url:(process.argv[3]||null),completed_at:process.argv[4],source_commit_sha:process.argv[5]}))' "${RUN_ID}" "${BUILD_ID}" "${BUILD_URL}" "${TS}" "${SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA}")"
          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error             -X PATCH "${SUPABASE_URL%/}/rest/v1/build_jobs?id=eq.${JOB_ID}"             -H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}"             -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}"             -H "Content-Type: application/json"             -H "Prefer: return=minimal"             -d "${JSON}"             || echo "::warning::Failed to update Supabase status (success)"

      - name: Update Build Status - Failed
        if: failure() && env.has_job_id == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TS="$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
          RUN_ID="${{ github.run_id }}"
          ERR="Build failed. Check logs: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
          SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          JSON="$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"error",github_run_id:process.argv[1],error_message:process.argv[2],completed_at:process.argv[3],source_commit_sha:process.argv[4]}))' "${RUN_ID}" "${ERR}" "${TS}" "${SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA}")"
          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error             -X PATCH "${SUPABASE_URL%/}/rest/v1/build_jobs?id=eq.${JOB_ID}"             -H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}"             -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}"             -H "Content-Type: application/json"             -H "Prefer: return=minimal"             -d "${JSON}"             || echo "::warning::Failed to update Supabase status (failed)"

name: EAS Link / Init

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Branch/Tag/SHA (optional)"
        required: false
        default: ""
      eas_project_id:
        description: "Existing EAS Project ID (optional)"
        required: false
        type: string
      expo_owner:
        description: "Expo account/organization (optional)"
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ inputs.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    env:
      EXPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}
      EAS_CLI_VERSION: "16.0.0"
      EAS_PROJECT_ID_INPUT: ${{ inputs.eas_project_id }}
      EXPO_OWNER_INPUT: ${{ inputs.expo_owner }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Validate secrets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${EXPO_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Secret EXPO_TOKEN"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ EXPO_TOKEN present (len=${#EXPO_TOKEN})"
          echo "Ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}"
          echo "EAS_PROJECT_ID_INPUT: ${EAS_PROJECT_ID_INPUT:-<empty>}"
          echo "EXPO_OWNER_INPUT: ${EXPO_OWNER_INPUT:-<empty>}"

      - name: Detect lockfile
        id: lock
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=package-lock.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=npm-shrinkwrap.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=yarn.lock" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            echo "has_lockfile=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=pnpm-lock.yaml" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_lockfile=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "lockfile_path=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Install deps (reproducible when possible)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "${{ steps.lock.outputs.has_lockfile }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "Using npm ci (lockfile: ${{ steps.lock.outputs.lockfile_path }})"
            npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
          else
            echo "::warning::No lockfile found. Falling back to npm install."
            npm install --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps
            if [ ! -f package-lock.json ]; then
              npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund || true
            fi
          fi

      - name: Install EAS CLI (pinned)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm i -g "eas-cli@${EAS_CLI_VERSION}"
          eas --version

      - name: Verify EAS auth (whoami)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eas whoami

      - name: EAS project:init (link/create)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          OWNER_ARGS=()
          if [ -n "${EXPO_OWNER_INPUT:-}" ]; then
            OWNER_ARGS=(--owner "${EXPO_OWNER_INPUT}")
          fi

          if [ -n "${EAS_PROJECT_ID_INPUT:-}" ]; then
            echo "Linking with EAS Project ID: ${EAS_PROJECT_ID_INPUT}"
            eas project:init --id "${EAS_PROJECT_ID_INPUT}" --non-interactive --force "${OWNER_ARGS[@]}"
            node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); fs.writeFileSync("eas-project.json", JSON.stringify({projectId: process.argv[1]}, null, 2)+"\n");' "${EAS_PROJECT_ID_INPUT}"
          else
            echo "No EAS Project ID provided. Running project:init and keeping generated eas-project.json..."
            eas project:init --non-interactive --force "${OWNER_ARGS[@]}"
            if [ ! -f eas-project.json ]; then
              echo "::warning::eas-project.json not found after project:init. Trying to read projectId from expo config..."
              npx --yes expo config --json > /tmp/expo-config.json
              PROJECT_ID="$(node -e 'const c=require("/tmp/expo-config.json"); process.stdout.write(String(c?.expo?.extra?.eas?.projectId||""));')"
              if [ -z "${PROJECT_ID}" ]; then
                echo "::error::Could not determine EAS projectId. Provide eas_project_id input (UUID) and re-run."
                exit 1
              fi
              node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); fs.writeFileSync("eas-project.json", JSON.stringify({projectId: process.argv[1]}, null, 2)+"\n");' "${PROJECT_ID}"
            fi
          fi

          echo "eas-project.json:"
          cat eas-project.json || true

      - name: Commit changes (if any)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
            exit 0
          fi

          BRANCH="$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD || true)"
          if [ -z "$BRANCH" ]; then
            echo "::warning::Detached HEAD -> not pushing changes."
            exit 0
          fi

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git commit -m "chore(eas): link/init projectId [skip ci]" || true
          git push origin "$BRANCH" || true

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo "## EAS Link / Init Summary"
            echo ""
            echo "- Ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}"
            echo "- SHA: ${GITHUB_SHA}"
            echo "- Checked out: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            echo "- EAS CLI: $(eas --version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
            echo "- Has EXPO_TOKEN: $([ -n "${EXPO_TOKEN:-}" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
            echo ""
            echo "Run: https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
